text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> PD:INCIDENT/PD12345

incident-bot: SEV=high | region=us-west-az13 | symptom=nic packet loss / high retries reported by fabric-monitor
incident-bot: affected-services: serving-gateway, routing-proxy

pagerduty: Incident routed to oncall schedule 'infra-us-west' -> escalation policy applied

sara_oncall: ack
sara_oncall: I'm oncall, looking. Can someone confirm if this is confined to az13 or across the region?

mike_sre: seeing link-level drops on az13 switches in telemetry (fabric-monitor). spikes in packet drops since 02:12 UTC
mike_sre: grafana -> https://grafana.internal/alerts/az13-nic-drop (added as comment)

jordan_plat: routing-proxy is reporting 5xx for a subset of requests. We're automatically diverting traffic but capacity in az12/14 is limited.

elaine_support: customer-impact: ~11% of requests to hosted API 5xx (short window), a few enterprise customers routed to dedicated capacity saw latency > 2s. No postmortem yet but support queue getting pings.

ben_devex: any ongoing deploys? I see a small canary started at 01:58 UTC but not related to NIC metrics.

sara_oncall: confirmed not deploy-related. Starting failover plan: 1) enable routing fallback for customer-facing routes to other AZs, 2) scale up dedicated fallback pool if possible, 3) throttle non-critical background batches.

sam_enginfra: initiating automated fallback: runbook step 2

sam_enginfra: command:
```
redwood-router set-fallback --region us-west --from az13 --to az12,az14 --mode gradual --max-ps 250
```
sam_enginfra: applied, monitoring KV cache warmup and error rates.

mike_sre: monitoring backend evictions. KV cache hitrate dips expected. If evictions > 10% for 5m, we'll enable prefix cache bypass for critical routes.

jordan_plat: enabling prefix cache bypass for /api/v1/generate
```
redwood-config routes update --path /api/v1/generate --cache bypass
```

sara_oncall: PD note -> acknowledging and taking lead. paging adviser: escalate to SRE lead if no progress in 15m.

pagerduty: Escalation: mike_sre -> paged

mike_sre: I'm here, running packet captures with netdiag, sharing logs.

mike_sre: netdiag summary: high RX drops on nic0 and nic1 on hosts in az13 rack 7. Potential hardware NIC flapping cluster-wide.

elaine_support: proactively messaged top-10 affected customers: CSAT team on standby, PS notified for enterprise hits.

ben_devex: temporary routing change looks stable, error rate dropped from 11% -> 3% in 4m after fallback started.

sara_oncall: good. keep routing fallback in gradual mode. Scaling dedicated fallback has +30% capacity now.

jordan_plat: rebalancer is kicking; some reassigns in progress. watch for KV cache misses.

sam_enginfra: node-repair queue opened with infra-hardware team to investigate NICs. PD ticket created: HW-7890

mike_sre: plan if degradation persists: 1) activate full az13 evacuation and mark az13 as draining for new workloads; 2) redirect internal control-plane endpoints; 3) start hardware replacement.

sara_oncall: we will avoid full evac for now; threshold to escalate = sustained 5xx > 8% for 10m. current 5xx trending down.

pagerduty: ack recorded by sara_oncall at 1798881250

jordan_plat: FYI -- started canary routing to az12 -> kept 10% traffic only, latency stable.

elaine_support: posting update to customers in status.redwood.ai

sara_oncall: handing off to nightshift
sara_oncall: @mike_sre taking lead for follow-up during overnight. I'll update incident doc and step down in 10m.

mike_sre: acknowledged, will maintain watch and escalate to hardware team if threshold hit. leaving a note in the runbook.

sara_oncall: thanks team. quick checklist before I step out:
- fallback active: yes
- dedicated pool scaled: yes (+30%)
- hardware ticket: HW-7890
- customer comms: posted

sara_oncall: stepping down, oncall handoff complete :white_check_mark:

mike_sre: continuing monitoring. current metrics: 5xx=2.6%, latency p50 ~120ms, p95 ~450ms.

incident-bot: auto-check in at +15m: 5xx < threshold -> no further immediate escalations.

mike_sre: marking incident as 'mitigated - monitoring'. I'll open a postmortem stub and link hardware replacement timeline. Assigning follow-ups: infra/hardware -> root cause, routing -> optimize fallback thresholds, devex -> customer rolling update notes.

elaine_support: prepping SLO blameless note for support and customer updates.

pagerduty: incident status -> mitigated (mitigation_by: routing fallback + scaling). PD incident: PD12345

sara_oncall: great work everyone. I'll finalize handoff notes in the incident doc. Closing thread for active handoff.
